Synopsis:
    UK public inflation expectations jumped in August (1Y: 3.9% vs 3.4%; long-term: 4.1% vs 3.7%), reversing recent declines. The rise is attributed in part to energy price pressures stemming from the Iran war. Citi flags this as a hawkish development but cautions against over-interpretation pending next month's data. The Bank of England is monitoring for second-round inflation effects.
